title.zh: 将南甘马粦省卡拉班加的曼吉灵的Jose De Villa纪念中学改设为Jose De Villa国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Jose De Villa Memorial High School in Manguiring, Calabanga, Camarines Sur Into the Jose De Villa National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Jose De Villa Memorial High School in Manguiring, Calabanga, Camarines Sur Into the Jose De Villa National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Jose De Villa tại Tỉnh Calabanga, Tỉnh Camarines Sur thành Trường Trung học Jose De Villa Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Jose De Villa ในจังหวัด Calabanga จังหวัด Camarines Sur เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Jose De Villa แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Sekolah Menengah Memorial Jose De Villa di Provinsi Calabanga, Provinsi Camarines Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah Jose De Villa Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Memorial Jose De Villa di Wilayah Calabanga, Wilayah Camarines Sur kepada Sekolah Menengah Jose De Villa Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8849_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Jose de Villa Memorial High School in Barangay Manguiring, Calabanga, Camarines Sur is hereby nationalized to be known as the Jose de Villa National High School.
All personnel, records, equipment, building, facilities and other properties of the Jose de Villa Memorial High School are hereby transferred to the Jose de Villa National High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Calabanga National High School- Barangay Manguiring Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the continuous operation and maintenance of the Jose de Villa National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval
